name: Kristina Šekrst
abstract: The question of machine consciousness rearticulates the classical problem of other minds in artificial domains. Since we have access only to outward behavior, any attribution of mentality to another system remains inferential. This difficulty becomes acute in the case of contemporary AI, whose outputs increasingly resemble human discourse.
